scope: independent exploration of existing stones and alternate role assignment; new skills are not applied

protocol.stage: independent second exploration after stage1 freeze
protocol.gear: all memory gems T3 power80 pure none, one current slot replaced, other party gear unchanged

slotMeaning.auxiliary: candidate replaces slot1 debuffer, original Seris/Nox primary attacker remains; original Liora/Athena crown remains

protocol.utilityPolicy: only pilot command changes: urgent guard/heal same; then buff/regen dispel, active barrier shatter, overclock when stronger ally unqueued gauge<=65, rewind when another ally normal cooldown is active, then legacy ultimate and damage. Autonomous allies retain native AI.
protocol.selection: For each candidate and scope, choose one fixed mode among eight by mean score across all6contexts on training10seeds; ties retain native-legacy then native-utility; no retuning on heldout. Validate native-legacy/native-utility and the chosen mode, plus selected gem with matched opposite command policy to separate equip/command effects.
limits: Auxiliary vs main parties have different members/total strengths and different job, do not treat cross-scope score difference as gem effect
No main69 distribution SD claim from these restricted fixtures
No exhaustive all stones/parties/manual target search
Utility-aware is an alternative test policy, not game UI or game AI update
Snapshot existing native stones, not new rescue mechanics
